step_skills.principle: From the room overview, identify candidate places where a small object like a keychain may be located, such as drawers, side tables, TV stands, and shelves, and begin systematic search.
step_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of the task when the room contains many receptacles and the keychain is not yet visible.

step_skills.title: Open Closed Containers Before Judging Them
step_skills.principle: If a candidate container such as a drawer is closed, open it to inspect its contents before deciding whether the target object is there.
step_skills.when_to_apply: When arriving at a closed container that could contain the keychain.

step_skills.title: Leave Empty Containers and Continue Search
step_skills.principle: If an opened container contains nothing, do not keep interacting with it; continue checking other candidate locations.
step_skills.when_to_apply: After opening a container and observing that it is empty.
step_skills.retrieval_obs: You open the drawer 1. The drawer 1 is open. In it, you see nothing.

step_skills.title: Inspect Visible Objects on Surfaces
step_skills.principle: When a surface has visible objects, check whether the keychain is among them. If only irrelevant objects are present, continue searching elsewhere.
step_skills.when_to_apply: When viewing a surface such as a side table that contains objects but not the keychain.
step_skills.retrieval_obs: You arrive at sidetable 1. On the sidetable 1, you see a remotecontrol 2, and a remotecontrol 1.

step_skills.title: Pick Up the Keychain When Found
step_skills.principle: Once the keychain is observed on a reachable surface, take it before going to the destination sofa.
step_skills.when_to_apply: When the observation explicitly shows a keychain on a surface, such as shelf 8.
step_skills.retrieval_obs: You arrive at shelf 8. On the shelf 8, you see a keychain 1, and a statue 3.

step_skills.title: Navigate to the Sofa After Acquiring the Keychain
step_skills.principle: After picking up the keychain, stop searching and go directly to the sofa, because the remaining task is placement.
step_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after the keychain has been picked up.
step_skills.retrieval_obs: You pick up the keychain 1 from the shelf 8.

step_skills.title: Place the Keychain in the Sofa
step_skills.principle: When at the sofa while holding the keychain, put the keychain in or on the sofa to complete the task, regardless of other objects already on the sofa.
step_skills.when_to_apply: When the agent is at sofa 1 holding the keychain.
step_skills.retrieval_obs: You arrive at sofa 1. On the sofa 1, you see a creditcard 1, and a pillow 1.
